step.label: Assess Operational Impact of Product Change
step.description: Evaluate how engineering changes affect production capabilities, workforce skills, and material requirements across the organization.
step.useCase: Manufacturing leadership needs to understand staffing and capability gaps before approving product transitions.

step.label: Plan Workforce Scheduling for Production Shift
step.description: Adjust employee schedules and manage time-off requests to ensure adequate staffing during the product changeover period.
step.useCase: Production planners must allocate trained personnel to support the engineering change implementation.

step.label: Register Engineering Change and Product Item Details
step.description: Formalize the engineering change with associated product item specifications and technical documentation in the system.
step.useCase: Engineering teams need a single source of truth for change specifications and product configuration during transition.

step.label: Validate BOM Compliance Against New Product Structure
step.description: Automate verification that bill-of-materials aligns with engineering specifications and detect compliance violations in material sourcing.
step.useCase: Quality and PLM teams must ensure that manufacturing can execute the new product design without sourcing conflicts.

step.label: Assess Supply Chain Readiness for New Materials
step.description: Analyze supplier availability, lead times, and cost implications for new or modified bill-of-material items required by the product transition.
step.useCase: Procurement teams need visibility into material availability and supplier capacity before committing to production schedules.

step.label: Update Compensation and Role Alignment for Impacted Workforce
step.description: Adjust employee compensation levels and verify role classifications align with new skill requirements and responsibilities introduced by the product change.
step.useCase: HR and Finance must ensure compensation structures reflect new competency levels required for the engineered product.

step.label: Create Service and Change Request Tickets
step.description: Generate formal change requests and service tickets to track implementation tasks, approvals, and IT/operational dependencies for the transition.
step.useCase: Operations teams need traceable audit trail and status visibility for all tasks required to execute the product transition safely.

step.label: Document Safety and Risk Assessment for Transition
step.description: Record potential safety incidents, environmental impacts, and operational risks associated with the engineering change and manufacturing transition.
step.useCase: EHS and operations leadership must identify and mitigate hazards before production changeover to protect workers and equipment.
